research_metadata.task_context: Market redesign: Meat/Market clean white card style, emoji→SVG migration, seller portal auth, philosophy section removal

recommended_color_system.rationale: Meat/Market reference uses pure white cards (#FFFFFF) with subtle 1px borders (#F1F5F9), high-contrast espresso typography (#1A1A1A), and pastel accent backgrounds for food category differentiation. Sky blue (#0369A1) retained as brand accent from existing design system.

recommended_typography.rationale: Existing font pairing is strong. Plus Jakarta Sans (700-900) for display headings and price callouts. Inter (400-600) for body text. Add JetBrains Mono for any numeric readouts (queue numbers, prices). Keep current Google Fonts import.

design_signals.recommended_animation_approach: Minimal — single orchestrated moment on page load (hero fade-in). No per-card animations. Status pulse ring on active order stage. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion.
trending_components: Clean white cards with rounded-[24px] and 1px border
SVG icon containers with pastel background circles
Modal auth overlay with centered card layout
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Emoji in any UI control or widget — replace with inline SVG
Duplicate content between hero and favorites sections
Gradient hero backgrounds — switch to clean white
Heavy shadows (shadow-2xl) — use shadow-xs for subtlety
Cloud/float animations — remove for clean static feel

key_apis: CSS @keyframes for single pulse moment only

recommended_templates.name: Clean white card patterns from Godly.website SOTD

component_composition_sources.zero_scratch_mandate: All components are vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN. No React/framework. SVG icons are inline, not from a component library.

community_verdict.sentiment_summary: Clean white card + SVG icon pattern is the dominant 2025-2026 food/market app aesthetic. Emoji in production UI is considered unprofessional. sessionStorage for simple auth gates is standard for client-side POS portals.
key_warnings: Do not use emoji in production UI — unprofessional, inconsistent rendering across platforms
sessionStorage auth is client-side only — no server-side protection. Acceptable for school POS portal.
Removing philosophy section may break footer anchor links — update all #cerita references
key_endorsements: Inline SVG with currentColor is the gold standard for icon systems in vanilla HTML projects
Rounded-[24px] cards with 1px border is the dominant food delivery app card pattern
Pastel background circles for food category differentiation is clean and accessible

pattern_evidence: SVG inline icons with viewBox 0 0 24 24 stroke-based pattern
Modal overlay with fixed inset-0 z-[100] for auth screens

ui_precedents: Meat/Market style: white cards, rounded-3xl, bold price display, weight/portion chips, zero emojis
Godly.website SOTD: clean card layouts with subtle borders and generous whitespace
Mobbin food delivery flows: pastel category differentiation, clean SVG iconography
design_references: Inline SVG icon system (Lucide/Phosphor pattern) for all 22 unique emoji replacements
Clean white card pattern with rounded-[24px] and border-gray-100
Pastel circle containers for food category icons
Modal auth overlay with centered card, SVG lock/user icons
